top_signals.title: $100 oil isn't turning Cramer bearish on stocks. Here are 3 reasons why
top_signals.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said he’s not ready to turn bearish despite mounting pressure from $100 oil and signs that higher gasoline prices are weighing on consumers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Citadel Securities Urges SEC to Take Oversight of Some Wagers
top_signals.summary: Citadel Securities told regulators that prediction market contracts linked to publicly-traded companies should be overseen by the Securities and Exchange Commission instead of the agency that has taken responsibility for them so far, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

top_signals.title: NFL teams still 'undervalued,' says Jacksonville Jaguars owner Shad Khan
top_signals.summary: Jacksonville Jaguars owner Shad Khan says NFL teams are still undervalued compared with teams in other professional sports leagues.
